thread:
Priya: Quick check — panel for candidate Ivy H. planned Wed 3/18 11:00 PT. Need ~60m interview + 30m debrief. Can folks confirm availability? Also need a quick decision on rubric weighting (system design vs runtime ops).

Kevin: I can make 11:00 PT but I have to hop after the interview, can't stay for the debrief.

Lina: 11:00 works for me, I can cover the debrief. Which rubric are we using? Last cycle we used eng-interview-rubric_v2.

Samir: FYI Ivy is an internal ref — focus areas should be distributed KV cache debugging and batching. For weighting, propose infra 40%, design 35%, communication 25%.

RecruiterBot: Event created: "Ivy H — Eng IC interview" 2027-03-18 11:00-12:00 PT. Calendar link: https://calendar.redwood.internal/event/abc123. Attendees: Priya, Kevin, Lina, Samir, Jordan.

Jordan: Heads-up I have a calendar clash 11:00-11:20. Can we push start to 11:30? Otherwise I'll join only for the debrief.

Priya: How about 11:15-12:15 interview, then 12:15-12:45 debrief? That buys Jordan some overlap and keeps total time similar.

Kevin: 11:15 works for me.

Lina: Works. On rubric weights — I'd prefer an even split but with infra sub-criteria for reliability/ops. Quick suggestion: use 1-4 scale and these weights.

Lina: ```
Scoring scale: 1 = needs work, 2 = below bar, 3 = meets bar, 4 = exceeds
Weights (proposal): Infra ops: 40% (reliability 20, debugging 20)
System design: 35%
Communication + collaboration: 25%
```

Samir: That looks good. I can lead infra questions and own those scores in the rubric.

Priya: Awesome. Small logistics: who will review the take-home/code sample before the interview? Jordan?

Jordan: I can review — please share the submission link and I'll add notes in the rubric prior to debrief.

Priya: Shared doc: https://redwood.internal/candidates/ivyh/rubric — please add your scores/comments by EOD tomorrow. Debrief at 12:15 PT, try to be punctual. :thumbsup:
